text_only.description: Text-only conversations, without images or captions

multimodal.description: Registered only; no importer or runner

scoring.answer_parsing: gpt_utils.get_cat_5_answer then strip for category 5 with choices; strip otherwise

equivalent: cat5 option order is uniform and reproducible from run_seed/sample_id; actual a/b mapping is recorded

notes: Official cat2/cat5 suffixes are added only after retrieval, in evaluator reader prompts; SUT query and public DTO remain unchanged.
A missing required suffix or private cat5 distractor forces partial fidelity, including older v1 bundles.
Raw release adversarial_answer is the cat5 distractor; if absent, an answer-only preprocessed row is supported.
Cat5 postprocess mirrors upstream: length 1 non-a and length 3 non-(a) map to b; other lengths use strip().lower().
Full fidelity retains the existing completeness/truncation checks; PRNG substitution is explicitly disclosed, and real model output quality is not implied.
